principle: Potential-fit institutions are not confirmed customers or current users. Official websites are listed from public institutional sources; outreach/usage requires explicit evidence or consent.

institutions.name: UNESCO
institutions.use_case: Public research, education, knowledge and accessibility-oriented digital tools; structured research artifacts and learning utilities.
institutions.source_basis: UNESCO publicly describes work spanning education, science, culture, communication/information and global data/knowledge access.

institutions.name: MIT
institutions.use_case: Research, education, developer and browser-based analytical/productivity tools.
institutions.source_basis: MIT public site presents research and education as core activities.

institutions.name: World Wide Web Consortium (W3C)
institutions.use_case: Web tooling, accessibility-oriented utilities, standards demonstrations and interoperable browser products.
institutions.source_basis: W3C develops web standards and emphasizes accessibility, privacy, security and interoperability.

institutions.name: Wikimedia Foundation
institutions.use_case: Knowledge tooling, content utilities, structured data and public-facing digital research products.
institutions.source_basis: Wikimedia Foundation publicly describes its role supporting the technology and policies behind free knowledge and Wikipedia.

institutions.name: NVIDIA
institutions.use_case: AI/ML/NLP developer utilities, visualization/3D workflows and browser-facing AI product demonstrations.
institutions.source_basis: NVIDIA publicly lists AI, developer tools, 3D/Omniverse and cloud services.
